summary: Lookout on the Mount Carleton peak, built 1923 with towermen until 1968; the trail guide describes the fire tower at the peak inside Mount Carleton Provincial Park.

facts.design: Frame cupola cabin from 1939, which replaced a 1923 log cabin

access.note: Trail to the peak inside Mount Carleton Provincial Park; park entrance is cash only.

visit.trail_note: 9.3 km loop trail from a parking area inside the park

events.note: Log cabin lookout station, per Canada Lookouts and the trail guide. The register says early 1920s.
John Hanna was the only towerman for many years
Modern frame cupola cabin replaced the old log cabin under a project reported by the Department of Lands and Mines
No longer manned after 1968; airplane patrols replaced towermen

corrections.why: The trail guide calls the park and peak Mount Carleton, and the 1923 and 1955 items on Canada Lookouts also use Carleton. The register and Canada Lookouts' own heading use Carlton. Flagged for a human to decide.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says early 1920s. The 1923 newspaper item and the trail guide both give 1923, so the story uses 1923.

sources.title: Mount Carleton Trail, Mount Carleton Provincial Park

notes_for_editor: Name: the record and register say Carlton; the trail guide, the 1923 item and the park say Carleton. A correction is proposed for human review. Verification 2026-10-20: the story no longer places the site in a county (the 1923 item and the 1939 report name different places, and county names are not used for this Canadian tower), so the story says only New Brunswick. Feet-only elevations now carry metres first. The 1939 project is described as reported by the Department of Lands and Mines, not as a government project. Conflicts: the 1923 newspaper item (on Canada Lookouts) and the 1939 report give 2,700 ft and 2,696 ft for the site; the register gives 808 m (2,650 ft) elevation and its description says the peak is 817 m. Trail page dates tower use to the early 1900s. Register coordinates (47.378056, -66.875833) and Canada Lookouts (47.365, -66.876) differ by about 1.5 km. Register says Greater Miramichi Rural District; the brief's local_unit is used as given. Kind unknown: sources describe both a cabin and a fire tower at the peak. Present-day standing rests on the trail guide (updated Dec 2025); no other source confirms it.
